name: Voice Orb
hint: Watch the conversation, then tap the orb while Sous speaks to interrupt. Space mutes, Esc ends.
description: The voice mode of an assistant, built around an orb you can read: its form says who is talking and how loudly, and each state holds up in a still frame. Ready is a disc that breathes twice and stops. Connecting is a hollow ring with a travelling arc. Listening opens into a ring whose rim and aperture follow the microphone. Thinking gathers into a small core inside a contracting orbit. Speaking pushes out three bands driven by the voice's low, mid and high energy. Muted is flat and struck through; error is a still broken ring with the reason and Retry. Forms morph on springs integrated against elapsed time, so the orb looks the same at 60 and 120 Hz. It is driven by real audio (a levels function or ref, or a Web Audio AnalyserNode), shows live captions whose words settle in, and carries mute, interrupt and end controls. Reduced motion swaps the morphing for a still form with a stepped level meter.
intents: voice assistant orb that reacts to audio
voice mode screen for an AI assistant with captions
audio-reactive speaking indicator for a voice chat
listening and speaking states for a voice call UI
microphone level visualizer with mute and end controls
usage: Use it for the voice mode of an assistant. It never opens the microphone: drive it from your own realtime session. Pass `state` (idle, connecting, listening, thinking, speaking, muted, error) from the session events, and the level from audio you already have: `analyser` (an AnalyserNode you created, on the mic while listening and on the playback while speaking) or `levels` (a function or ref returning { low, mid, high, volume } in 0..1); `attack` / `release` smooth it in milliseconds. Pass `captions` as [{ who: "user" | "assistant", text, final, interrupted }] from your transcription; words settle in as `text` grows. Wire `onMute(next)`, `onEnd`, `onInterrupt` (tapping the orb while it speaks, or the Interrupt button), `onStart` (tapping the orb when idle) and `onRetry`; control mute with `muted` (or start it with `defaultMuted`). Name the assistant with `assistantName`, add `context` and `elapsed` (seconds) for the lg header, `error` for the reason shown in the error state, and `labels` to reword any state. Space toggles mute and Esc ends while focus is inside. `size` sm is a 40px pill for a composer, md a card, lg a full voice screen. Reduced motion holds a still form per state with a stepped level meter. Without `demo` it shows only what you pass: no captions, no timer, no script. With `demo` the recorded kitchen conversation plays and a "Use my microphone" button can ask for the mic; that is the only path that ever calls getUserMedia.
